_note: The company's departments and roles, shown by the Company view (company/) and summed up in agents/README.md. A role whose id is an agent in agents/schedule.json takes its on or off from there, so it has no status here. Every other role has status planned and switch_on_when. kind is agent, product or people; owner and lead are founders. KPIs are counts only, each with a label, a source and how it is counted: files dated in a folder, open Issues with a human: label, merged pull requests tagged with an agent, or a key in ops/kpis.json. No money amounts, no patient data, no private person's name. Change it through a reviewed pull request; company/tests/departments.test.js checks it.

departments.name: Operations
departments.mission: Keep the company running and both founders informed.

kpis.label: Issues waiting on a founder
kpis.source: Open Issues with a human: label

roles.title: Chief of staff
roles.job: Daily digest, filing and the work board.

departments.name: Engineering
departments.mission: Build the claims software and keep every change safe.

kpis.label: Score on the 50 made-up claims
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key fake_claims_score, from the engineer's test report

kpis.label: Pull requests merged in the last 7 days by the engineer
kpis.source: Pull requests tagged [engineer], merged on GitHub

roles.title: Engineer
roles.job: Builds and tests the demo on made-up claims.

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.job: Checks every pull request against CLAUDE.md and never merges.

departments.name: Brand and Marketing
departments.mission: Make the company look trustworthy to small US practices.

kpis.label: Design pieces merged in the last 7 days
kpis.source: Pull requests tagged [design], merged on GitHub

roles.title: Design
roles.job: Pages and design pieces from the design system.

roles.title: Marketing
roles.job: Drafts LinkedIn posts and pages on common denial codes for a founder to publish.
roles.switch_on_when: When the domain is bought and the website is live.

departments.name: Sales and Customers
departments.mission: Find practices, win pilots and keep them happy.

kpis.label: Calls booked
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key calls_booked, filed by a founder

kpis.label: Pilot practices signed
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key pilots_signed, filed by a founder

roles.title: Sales
roles.job: Prospect lists, call scripts and email drafts.

roles.title: Customer success
roles.job: Each practice's onboarding checklist and monthly report from totals.
roles.switch_on_when: When the first pilot practice signs.

departments.name: Claims Operations
departments.mission: Turn denials into won appeals, each checked by a trained person.

kpis.label: Appeals sent
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key appeals_sent, filed by a founder (from phase 7)

kpis.label: Appeals won
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key appeals_won, filed by a founder (from phase 7)

roles.title: Appeal drafter
roles.job: Drafts each appeal inside the claims system under BAAs, never in this repository.

roles.title: Trained reviewers
roles.switch_on_when: When the pilot proves the process.

departments.name: Research and Insights
departments.mission: Know the rules, the insurers and the market.

kpis.label: Research notes in the last 30 days

roles.title: Research
roles.job: Weekly watch on rules, insurers, the market and competitors.

roles.title: Data analyst
roles.switch_on_when: When the first 10 appeal decisions are back.

departments.name: Finance and Legal
departments.mission: Keep the money, the contracts and HIPAA in order.

kpis.label: Open questions for the lawyer
kpis.source: ops/kpis.json key lawyer_questions_open, filed by a founder

roles.title: Finance
roles.job: Invoice drafts and a 13-week cash forecast, never moves money.
roles.switch_on_when: When the US company and its bank account exist.

roles.title: Legal and contracts
roles.job: Fills practice agreements and BAAs and tracks renewal dates, never signs or sends.
roles.switch_on_when: When the lawyer approves the templates.

roles.title: Compliance monitor
roles.job: The BAA register, training reminders and a monthly report, never opens claims data.
